basedir.description: Base directory under which home and group directories are created.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the autodir daemon.

loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: 0 = none, 5 = debug. Higher values produce more detail.

backend.description: User/group data source. Choose from: ldap, nis, sql, or local.

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI (e.g., ldap://host:port or ldaps://host:port). Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_base.description: Default search base for LDAP. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_binddn.description: DN used to bind to LDAP (anonymous if empty). Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_bindpw.description: Password for LDAP bind DN. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP filter to match user entries. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_group_filter.description: LDAP filter to match group entries. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_user_basedn.description: Base DN for user searches under ldap_base. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_group_basedn.description: Base DN for group searches under ldap_base. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_attr_uid.description: LDAP attribute name for the username. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_attr_gid.description: LDAP attribute name for the group ID. Only used with backend=ldap.

ldap_attr_homedir.description: LDAP attribute name for the home directory path. Only used with backend=ldap.

nis_domain.description: NIS domain name. Only used with backend=nis.

nis_server.description: NIS server hostname/IP. If empty, uses local ypbind. Only used with backend=nis.

sql_driver.description: SQL driver: postgresql, mysql, sqlite, etc. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_server.description: SQL server hostname or socket path. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_port.description: SQL server port. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_database.description: SQL database name. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_user.description: SQL username for authentication. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_password.description: SQL user password. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_user_table.description: Name of the SQL table storing user info. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_group_table.description: Name of the SQL table storing group info. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_user_query.default: SELECT username, uid, gid, homedir FROM users WHERE username = ?
sql_user_query.description: SQL query to fetch a user by name. Uses ? as placeholder for username. Only used with backend=sql.

sql_group_query.default: SELECT groupname, gid FROM groups WHERE groupname = ?
sql_group_query.description: SQL query to fetch a group by name. Uses ? as placeholder for groupname. Only used with backend=sql.

passwd_file.description: Path to local passwd file. Only used with backend=local.

shadow_file.description: Path to local shadow file (optional, used for password expiry checks). Only used with backend=local.

group_file.description: Path to local group file. Only used with backend=local.

mkdir_template.description: Shell command template used to create and configure directories. Supports %u (username), %h (homedir), %g (groupname), %m (permissions).

uid_default.description: Default UID to assign if lookup fails or is missing (fallback only).

gid_default.description: Default GID to assign if lookup fails or is missing (fallback only).

mode_dir.description: Octal permissions for newly created directories (e.g., '0700').

mode_file.description: Octal permissions for newly created files (e.g., '0644').

skeleton_dir.description: Source directory for skeleton files to copy into new home directories.

skeleton_files.description: List of filenames to copy from skeleton_dir to new home directories. Empty list skips copying.

pre_create.description: Shell command to run before directory creation. Use %u to interpolate username.

post_create.description: Shell command to run after successful directory creation. Use %u to interpolate username.

max_creates_per_sec.description: Maximum directory creation rate per second to prevent system overload.

max_creates_per_user_per_min.description: Maximum number of directories that may be created for a single user per minute.

lookup_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for user/group lookup (e.g., LDAP/SQL query).

create_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for directory creation (including hooks).

reload_on_config_change.description: If true, autodir reloads its configuration without restart when the config file is updated.

debug.description: If true, run in debug mode: log verbosely and perform dry-run (no actual writes).
